title: Frindship Flag Exchange #16
summary: Rtn Vipul Vasa visited the oldest Club RC Athinai, Greece in the whole Mediterranean and Balkan Region.
description: Rtn Vipul Vasa visited the oldest Club RC Athinai, Greece in the whole Mediterranean and Balkan Region. The President of the Club turned out to be in the very same business as Vipul and hence invited him to meet for further discussions on doing business together. This, according to Vipul , is the power of the Rotary and the benefit of a Flag Exchange!
